description: Load an image (absolute local path or https URL), resize it to fit the LED grid, and optionally push it to the display. An animated GIF or WebP pushes as an animation of up to maxFrames frames (default 40), sampled evenly from a longer source and played at the speed that keeps its loop length; past 40 frames it plays as one GIF the device downloads from this host. Returns the downsampled result as an image content block so you see exactly what the display received — for an animation, a grid of its frames, evenly sampled once they outnumber what fits the sheet. Nearest-neighbor kernel preserves pixel art; use lanczos3 or mitchell for photos. finish reduces the result to a small or fixed palette, optionally dithered.

anyOf.description: Reduce to a palette built from the image.

colors.description: Build a palette of at most this many colors (2–256) from the image itself.

dither.description: How palette colors are placed: none maps each pixel to its nearest color; bayer4 mixes the two nearest in an ordered 4×4 pattern; floyd-steinberg diffuses the difference to neighboring pixels, smoothest on photos.

How palette colors are placed: none maps each pixel to its nearest color; bayer4 mixes the two nearest in an ordered 4×4 pattern; floyd-steinberg diffuses the difference to neighboring pixels, smoothest on photos.

palette.description: Map every pixel to these colors (1–256 entries).

items.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #RGB) or a named color.

finish.description: Reduce the image to a palette before it reaches the panel: exactly one of colors (2–256, built from the image) or palette (1–256 hex or named colors), plus dither. Transparent pixels stay unlit and are not counted. The preview shows the finished frame.

fit.description: Resize fit mode: contain (letterbox), cover (crop to fill), fill (stretch).

kernel.description: Resize kernel: nearest for pixel art, lanczos3 for photos, mitchell for a balance.

maxFrames.description: Most frames an animated source pushes (1–800, default 40); a longer source is sampled evenly down to it. Up to 40 push frame by frame; more play as one GIF the device downloads from this host, so the device must reach it (behind NAT or a firewall, set PIXOO_SERVE_HOST and PIXOO_SERVE_PORT), and speed rounds to the nearest 10 ms. A still ignores it.

push.description: Push the resized image to the device (default: true).

source.description: Absolute local file path or https (not http) URL of the image to display; a relative path is rejected. An animated GIF or WebP, whatever its file name, pushes as an animation.

speed.description: Milliseconds per frame for an animated source (10–2000). Default: the source's total duration over the pushed frame count, or 150 when it records no delays. A still ignores it.

name: pixoo_push_image

deviceState.description: Device state after the push. Absent when push: false.

brightness.description: Current brightness level (0–100). Absent when device is unreachable.

clockId.description: Current clock face ID (faces channel only). Absent on other channels.

screenOn.description: True if screen is on. Absent when device is unreachable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `device_unreachable`: Device is not reachable. `device_http_error`: The device answered with a non-2xx HTTP status (retryable for 408, 429, 500, and 502–504). `device_rejected`: Device firmware returned a non-zero error code. `gif_serve_failed`: An animation of more than 40 frames could not be served to the device: its listener failed to open, its URL ran past 255 bytes, or the device did not request the GIF within 10 s of the play, stalled its transfer for 10 s, or dropped it. `no_device_configured`: PIXOO_IP is not set. `asset_not_found`: Image path or URL could not be read. `invalid_image`: The source was read but did not decode as an image. `invalid_color`: A finish palette entry could not be resolved to a color. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

frames.description: Frames rendered and pushed: 1 for a still, 2 to maxFrames for an animation.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths to saved preview files: a PNG for a still, an 8× GIF at the pushed speed for an animation, or past 40 frames the panel-size GIF the device downloads. Present only when PIXOO_OUTPUT_DIR is configured.

pushed.description: True when the device acknowledged the push; past 40 frames, once it accepted the GIF play, requested the file, and the whole file was handed to the OS to send (the device does not confirm receipt).

sourceFrames.description: Frames in the source before sampling down to maxFrames: 1 for a still.

speed.description: Milliseconds per frame the animation plays at. Absent for a still.
